compose.cmd:
exec docker compose -f compose.yml -f - up --abort-on-container-failure <<'YAML'
services:
  plausible_db:
    restart: "no"
  plausible_events_db:
    restart: "no"
  plausible:
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: "${SECRET_KEY_BASE}${SECRET_KEY_BASE}"
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:${HTTP_PORT}"
YAML
